description: Atlyn Overlap Explorer helps Power BI report authors examine how distinct entities belong to overlapping sets, such as customers using products or users adopting features. Bind Entity ID and Set Name from a long-form membership table. Repeated entity/set observations are grouped without inflating entity counts. Exact mode shows exclusive combinations among retained sets. Inclusive mode counts entities belonging to every named set while allowing other memberships; inclusive groups can overlap and are not additive totals. Explore set-size bars and a dot matrix of ranked combinations. Search and page through contributors. Select contributors through Power BI entity identities, or select a set margin to target loaded members of that set. An optional positive Highlight signal enables distinct highlighted-entity presence rather than weighted counting. The displayed universe is the set of valid entities in the received data snapshot. Include blank Set Name observations for entities with no memberships. Entities absent from delivered data are not inferred. Data reduction, invalid rows, and omitted sets are disclosed. Analysis is bounded to six retained sets by default, configurable to ten; twenty combinations by default, up to fifty; and 30,000 processed rows per aggregate snapshot.
